name: ssh-web-terminal
description: Browser-based SSH terminal with multi-session tabs (React + xterm.js frontend, Node/ssh2 backend).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
